name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd
about: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd is an integrated power plant equipment manufacturer engaged in design, engineering, manufacture, erection, testing, commissioning and servicing of a wide range of products and services for the core sectors of the economy, viz. Power, transmission, Industry, transportation, renewable energy, Oil & Gas and defence. [1] It is the flagship engineering and manufacturing company of India owned and controlled by the Govt. of India. [2]
key_points: Business Segments [1] a) Power Sector (77% in Q1 FY27 vs 71% in Q1 FY26): [2] The Power Segment comprises equipment supplies and EPC works for Coal and Lignite, Gas, Hydro, and Nuclear Power Plant businesses, as well as the Spares & Services business, including the new Coal-to-Chemicals business. As of FY26, the company accounted for 54% of India’s total installed utility-scale thermal power capacity, 60% of installed nuclear capacity (secondary side) and 43% of installed hydropower capacity. Overall, across thermal, nuclear and hydro segments, it held a 53% share of the country’s total installed conventional utility-scale capacity. Since its inception in 1964, it has supplied 476 coal-based, 23 diesel, 431 hydro, 105 gas-based, and 15 nuclear utility sets in India through FY26. [3] The company’s installed base comprises 1,050 sets with a total capacity of approximately 1,78,995 MW , including 1,43,010 MW from coal-based power projects. It has also undertaken 62 projects of 1,150 MW solar projects in India. It has commissioned/synchronised 8,850 MW in FY26, comprising 8340 MW in the domestic market and 510 MW in the export market. [4] [5]

profile.summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited operates as power plant equipment manufacturer in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Power and Industry. It offers equipment supplies; spares and services; and undertakes engineering, procurement, and construction works for coal and lignite, gas, hydro and nuclear power plant, transportation, transmission, defence, aerospace, captive power plants, process, renewables, upstream and downstream oil and gas, e-mobility and energy storage, and other industries. The company also provides coal based, gas-based, nuclear, and hydro power plants, as well as solar power systems; rail, transportation and transmission systems; defense and aerospace products; industrial systems; and battery energy storage system and e-mobility solutions. In addition, it offers steam generators and steam generator auxiliaries, soot blowers, valves, piping systems, seamless steel tubes, valves, pressurized fluidized bed gasifiers, steam and gas turbines, turbo generators, industrial sets, castings and forgings, condenser and heat exchangers, pumps, Hydro Power Plants, compressors, and automation and control systems. Further, the company provides software system solutions, medium voltage vacuum switchgears, on load tap changers, LT switchgears and bus ducts, transformers and reactors, capacitors, bushings, control gears, insulators and ceramics, and electrical machines. It also provides rail transportation systems and equipment, defence and aerospace, oil field equipment, and fabricated equipment and mechanical packages. The company has a strategic collaboration with E2S Company Limited for the development of excitation systems for synchronous machines. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is based in New Delhi, India.
